title: The Royal Trial (first full midpoint attempt)

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The Palace Court is holding the Royal Trial, a ceremony to honor the kingdom’s guardians.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Unofficially, it is testing how much bronze will fit on one podium.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Sixth speech. Thirty-one pages. All of them praising my ability to stand still.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Do they know you have other talents?”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A herald invites her to light a ceremonial warding sigil above the platform. It is meant to glow for a moment, symbolically.

intro.speaker: HERALD
intro.text: “A gentle flame, Your Highness! Just enough for the court to admire its protection!”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She raises one hand. A thin band of amber light traces the sigil.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Then a spark snaps sideways and pops against the empty edge of the platform.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nobody is struck. An attendant flinches. Half the front row tries to leave through the same door and trips over the other half.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The spark fizzles out well short of the banners.

intro.speaker: HERALD
intro.text: “Remain calm! Move away from the platform in an orderly—my shoe! Has anyone seen my shoe?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “That was not the pattern I intended.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She closes her hand, and the sigil goes dark at once. Her wings stay folded. Her eyes are already on the crowded aisle.

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “The spark’s out. People are bunching up at the doorway.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Yes. They saw it. They saw me lose control.”

options.labelText: “Your magic’s stopped. Let’s give people room and have the attendants clear the aisle. Then talk somewhere quiet?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Yes. Tell the herald the side aisle is clear. I will check the platform.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You steer people toward the side aisle while the attendants open the way. Kaedra checks the platform edge, then every face in the front row.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Nobody is hurt. The room settles. Someone hands the herald back his shoe.

branch.speaker: HERALD
branch.text: “The ceremony has concluded! The speeches will resume after an interval of several years.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Later, under an arch within the Palace Court, Kaedra stands with her arms folded hard, holding herself steady.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “When it went sideways, I knew how to stop it.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I also knew what they would think. That I had finally become the danger they were waiting for.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “It caught you by surprise. You stopped it anyway. Then you checked every face in the front row.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “And you owned it before anyone asked. So you’re shaken. That’s one bad minute out of a lot of good ones.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “They ask me to be a shield. Nobody has written the regulations for a shield that gets frightened.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I thought you might come here to admire the spectacle.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Or to tell me I need protecting from myself.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I came because I care how you feel. What happens next is up to you.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The line of her jaw loosens. She lets out a long, slow breath.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “That is an alarmingly sensible answer. I may have to invite you to future ceremonies. As a precaution.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “Do they come with fewer speeches?”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I do not make promises I cannot keep.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “But stay a little longer?”

options.labelText: “That was incredible! Forget the crowd. Do a bigger one and they’ll never forget it.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “No.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She turns away to direct the attendants and checks the platform herself. When she comes back, her voice is cool.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “A frightened crowd is not an audience I need to impress.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I was trying to be supportive.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I know. You meant the bigger one as a compliment.”

options.labelText: “Stand down. I’ll decide when it’s safe for you to use magic again.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Declaring yourself in charge of me does not make you responsible for me.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She turns to the attendants. The aisle is clear in under a minute, and the sigil stays dark.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I can account for what happened. You could have helped the people at the door.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “You’re right. I spoke over you.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “You did. I would like you to think about why.”
